_comment: Examples whose golden cannot be matched exactly, with the reason. tools/regress.mjs reports them as 'known' instead of warn/fail. Keep this list short: every entry needs a reason that is not a manim-web bug.
ContinuousMotion: StreamLines seeds its start points with unseeded numpy randomness; every Manim render differs
GraphAutoPosition: Graph layout uses networkx's spring layout with a random initial state
ImportNetworkxGraph: networkx spring layout: random initial state
SpringLayout: networkx spring layout: random initial state
BraceBPExample: Manim's saved last frame draws the static background twice (brighter grid than its own frame 35, although nothing changes during the final wait); frames during the scene match
LinearTransformationSceneExample: Manim's saved last frame draws the static background twice (brighter grid than its own frame 35, although nothing changes during the final wait); frames during the scene match
